title: roldana barba-johannis
intro: Roldana barba-johannis, commonly known as Mexican Gold or Gold Dust Plant, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family. The plant is known for its bright yellow daisy-like flowers and is prized for its potential health benefits. The health benefits of Roldana barba-johannis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which may help to reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation and better sleep. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions.
